digest.component_or_area: LLM model selection and class resolution across verifier paths
propositions: Three independent code paths (verify.py, completion.py, code-review.yaml) break off the default verifier model by comparing cfg.model against DEFAULT_MODEL, silently downgrades non-default models instead of resolving configured class names.

Code-review's Pass-2 verify step declares temperature: 0 for greedy determinism but has no model: key, causing it to run on frontier model where the Anthropic adapter silently drops the temperature setting.
Provider-qualified model ids (e.g. anthropic:claude-opus-4-8) defeat string equality tests against bare default ids, causing verifier selection to leak to frontier when providers change.

resolve_model_string() and its call sites must resolve reserved class names (trivial/standard/frontier) through load_class_slots() while returning literal model ids unchanged for backward compatibility.

The xcheck callers at xcheck.py:198 and xcheck.py:336 do not exercise _verifier_cfg through their actual call chain, creating a gap where the verifier model can silently inherit cfg.model instead of resolving the configured class.
